arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/log.jsonl && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
text=data.decode('utf-8')
for i,line in enumerate(text.split('\n'),1):
    if line.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(obj.get('code'))
out={"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid}
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(open('scratch/errors.json',encoding='utf-8').read())
EOF
